title: Rasan Khol Do
body:
Mere baba gale ki rasan khol do
Shaah ki ladli kar rhi hai buka
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Ek rasan me bandhe haaye bara gale
Koi apna nahi kisko awaz de
Aap baqi rahe aur na mere chacha
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Hun musalsal giraftare ranjo mehan
Itni sakhti se bandhi gyi hai rasan
Kya nahi hoga ab zakhm achha mera
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Usme phupyon ke bazu bhi jakrhe gye
qad hai Chhota mera sabke qad hain barhe
kya isi tarh jeena parhega sada
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Koi bibi jo uthi rasan khich gyi
jisse haaye meri saans rukne lagi
Ghut ta hai dam mera aao baba zara
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Ab talak kano se bah raha hai lahu
Is musibat ki kisse karun guftugu
Kya yateemo ko milti hai aisi saza
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Purse mujhko yateemi ke kaise mile
Pusht par durre mu pe tamache lage
Rasiyon se gala bhi mera chhil gya
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Baba seene pe mai apke soi hun
Apke sath mai na kabhi roi hu
Aaj ro ro ko krti hun mai ilteja
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Baba ayen madine chale jayen ham
Jake apne watan me sukun payen ham
Koi apna nahi hai yahan par mera
<<DIVIDER>>
9. Wo setam ho gya aye reyaze hazi
Kaanp utha falak hil gyi thi zami
Jab sakina ki gunji faza me sada
<<DIVIDER>>
Mere baba gali ki rasan khol do
author: Reyaz Ali Bhikpuri
